The test image shows a corn leaf with numerous small dark (black) spots scattered across the surface, along with tan/brown irregular lesions. Dark spots appear on and near the midrib. This is a **leaf** disease.

Top candidates from the leaf class list based on visual features:
- **Tar_Spot**: black glossy raised stromata
- **Physoderma_Brown_Spot**: small brown spots in bands + dark spots on midrib
- **Holcus_Spot**: tan/white spots with dark margins
- **Southern_Corn_Leaf_Blight**: tan rectangular lesions

Let me view reference images one at a time, starting with my top candidates.
Tar Spot reference shows dark spots on a mostly green leaf. The test image has much more extensive tan/brown lesioning in addition to the dark spots. Let me check Physoderma Brown Spot.

Strong match. Physoderma Brown Spot shows yellowish-brown spots in bands with dark spots concentrated along the midrib, very similar to the test image pattern. Let me continue checking other candidates.
Holcus Spot shows a single, distinct tan/white spot on a clean green leaf. Very different from the test image's dense pattern of many spots. Not a match.
SCLB shows distinct rectangular tan lesions with brown margins, quite different from the dense scattered spots in the test image. Not a match.

Eyespot shows numerous small circular spots with distinct tan centers and brown/purple rings (the "eye" pattern) on a green leaf. The test image spots are darker and more irregular, without the characteristic eye pattern. Not a match.
Southern Rust shows orange/cinnamon pustules, very different from the dark black spots in the test image. Not a match.

Anthracnose shows larger spindle-shaped lesions with dark margins on leaf edges. Very different from the test image's dense scattered small spots. Not a match.

Now let me view a second Physoderma Brown Spot reference to confirm the match, since I've used 7 views across 7 classes.

This confirms the match. This second Physoderma Brown Spot reference shows the same pattern as the test image:
- Numerous small yellowish-brown spots scattered across the leaf blade in bands
- Dark purplish-black oval spots concentrated along the midrib
- Mix of small tan/brown spots on the leaf surface with darker spots on the midrib

The test image matches Physoderma Brown Spot very closely. The key diagnostic features are all present: small brown spots in broad bands across the leaf, and the characteristic dark (purplish-black) spots on the midrib.
